image_prompt.text: Wide, flat, grid-aligned city streets — 15 studs minimum one-way, 30 studs two-way — running between the commercial strips and the residential blocks so cars and police cruisers turn without clipping walls
Clear physical separation between the loud commercial downtown — storefronts, banks, gas stations — and the quieter residential streets
Banks, shops and gas stations along the city streets that players actually go inside
A dense city block grid of skyscrapers and mid-rise commercial buildings rather than scattered individual structures
Pedestrians walking the sidewalks, crossings and shopfronts of the city
Moving traffic circulating on the road network, with police cruisers among the civilian vehicles

layout_placement.text: Ambient pedestrian population occupying the sidewalks, crossings and forecourts, non-hostile and spread across the districts

notes: Preset Life kept for its vehicle road network, zoned districts and enterable buildings, but the shape was substituted: settlement-claimable replaced with settlement-static, because the prompt describes a pre-built realistic city with no player-owned, claimable or buildable housing — residential districts are scenery, not property.

P3 comes from building-interior, not from the shape. A GTA-style city whose named features are banks, gas stations and commercial strips with interactive elements plainly goes indoors, so the modifier is treated as earned rather than assumed.

P3 is not a route that is ready to build yet. If it needs to ship on the proven pipeline, dropping building-interior leaves storefront facades only and returns the whole map to P0 — recorded here as the deferral.

Close call on a second genre: a Simulation reading (drivable vehicles, police/criminal job loops) was considered and rejected, because the dominant genre's path-road-vehicle option already expresses the driving city and the prompt states no repeatable job task loop. If the intended loop really is police/robber shift work, this becomes ["roleplay-avatar-sim", "simulation"].

"All GTA5 gameplay elements ready for installation with animations and interactive elements" and "normal character support" are scripting, rigging and R6/R15 asset requests. They are not layout geometry and nothing in the handoff can carry them, so they are recorded here rather than dropped.

would have asked: Sounds like a city-life layout — a pre-built realistic city, no player-owned houses, two-way vehicle streets wide enough for traffic, a commercial downtown of skyscrapers kept apart from residential streets, banks, shops and gas stations you can walk into, and pedestrian crowds on the sidewalks. Want that, or would you rather build it up yourself?

would have asked: Are the banks, shops and gas stations actually enterable, or storefront facades only? Enterable interiors have to be generated separately, which is a slower build and isn't ready yet — facades only would keep the whole city on the proven single-pass route.

would have asked: Do players own or claim any of the housing, or is the residential district purely scenery? Claimable houses would change the shape and add the same interior cost across the whole neighbourhood.
would have asked: Anything else you want in the space?
